Details of the initiative (Web-Link, if any, may be provided along with summary.
• Installed highly efficient UPS through cooling system.

These measures resulted in significant reduction in energy losses, improved operational efficiency, and enhanced sustainability performance. The initiative reflects the Company’s continued commitment toward responsible energy management and reduction of environmental impact through adoption of energy-efficient technologies.
• Installed Retrofit Emission Control Device (RECD) on diesel generators (DG sets)

Emission reductions are estimated based on manufacturer- certified performance data of Retrofit Emission Control Devices (RECD), which indicate a reduction efficiency of 70%–90% for Particulate Matter (PM), Carbon Monoxide (CO), and Hydrocarbons (HC) from DG set exhaust emissions.

1. Rainwater Harvesting is the sustainable collection and storage of rain from surfaces like rooftops or land to combat water scarcity, reducing reliance on municipal supplies 2. Sewage Treatment Plants Initiative helps in the conservation of freshwater resources through reuse of treated wastewater for non-potable needs like irrigation, industrial cooling, and toilet flushing and reducing the dependency on external freshwater sources, improved water management practices and strengthened environmental sustainability through responsible water conservation measures.
• Replaced single use paper glass to ceramic cups • Reused RO wastewater • Recycled food and organic waste

1. Replaced single use paper glass to reusable ceramic cups As part of its waste minimization and sustainable workplace practices, the Company has transitioned from single-use paper cups to reusable ceramic cups across its office locations. This measure has led to an estimated 50% reduction in paper cup consumption, contributing to a reduction in office-generated waste. 2. Reused RO wastewater The Company has implemented a wastewater reuse practice generated from the RO system that is reused for non-potable purposes such as cleaning, flushing, and horticulture activities. The initiative contributed towards reduction in freshwater consumption and improved water resource management 3. Recycled food and organic waste Generated within the premises is composted and reused as manure for in- house horticulture activities.
